name: Banh bong lan trung muoi
summary: Bánh bông lan trứng muối is sponge cake topped with salted egg yolk, cheese, and pork floss. The sweet cake plays against the salt of the yolk and the cheese.
origin: Vung Tau, where it is eaten as a snack or a sweet.
taste: The cake is sweet, and the salted yolk and cheese bring the salt.
howToEat: Eat a slice as a snack or a sweet.
seoTitle: Banh bong lan trung muoi — salted-egg sponge in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Salted-egg sponge in Vung Tau: sweet sponge cake with salted egg yolk, cheese, and pork floss.
